senses.gloss:
(ऋ) शौटृ r. 1st cl. (शौटति)
To be proud.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Proud, haughty.
m. (-रः)
1 A hero.
2 An ascetic, one who abandons the world.
3 A proud or haughty man, but of low tribe or occupation, an upstart.
E.
शौट to be proud, and ईरन् Uṇādi aff.; also as derived from शौड the same, शौडीर; also the short vowel being substituted for the diphthong, शुटीर.

n. (-र्य्यं)
1 Heroism, prowess.
2 Pride, arrogance.
E.
शौटीर a hero, and ष्यञ् aff.
